quizV3.welcome.bubble: Welcome to OUT! We train outdoors, in outdoor gyms and parks, mostly with our own bodyweight. It’s called calisthenics.
quizV3.welcome.title: What is calisthenics?
quizV3.welcome.body: In a gym you add weight. Here we change the exercise: the angle, the leverage, one arm instead of two. For your muscles it’s the same load, and your body can’t tell the difference.
quizV3.welcome.ladder.label: Three push exercises, from easier to harder
quizV3.welcome.ladder.homeAndPark: Every exercise has a version for home and for the outdoor gym
quizV3.welcome.skills: Special skills like the planche and handstand are the advanced stage of calisthenics.
quizV3.main.title: A quick test, no sweat
quizV3.main.step1: For each muscle group you’ll see several exercises, from easier to harder.
quizV3.main.step2: Swipe sideways to the hardest exercise you’re sure you can do.
quizV3.main.step3: It’s fine to have gaps between muscle groups. That’s exactly why we test each one separately.
quizV3.main.reassure: Don’t know an exercise? Not sure? Pick your best guess. We’ll fine-tune it from your first workouts.
quizV3.main.videoLink: Not sure what to do? Watch a short explainer video

quizV3.explain1.bubble: Wait, what does “Level {level} in {group, select, push {push} pull {pull} legs {legs} core {core} other {}}” mean?
quizV3.explain1.body: Each level is a set of exercises at the same difficulty. This is what your {group, select, push {push} pull {pull} legs {legs} core {core} other {}} map looks like:
quizV3.explain1.footer: You can find the full map for each group in the Progress tab.
quizV3.explain2.title: Every workout fills the ring
quizV3.explain2.bullet1: Each workout adds a few percent, based on what you actually did.
quizV3.explain2.bullet2: At 100% you level up and get more advanced exercises.
quizV3.explain2.bullet3: OUT learns your progress, so it’s always a challenge, never too easy and never too hard.
quizV3.explain3.title: Workouts that fit your schedule
quizV3.explain3.body: On the home screen, tell us when you’re free to train, and OUT fits workouts to your level and progress.
quizV3.explain3.lemur: And I’ll track your progress. When the time comes, I’ll suggest when to add another plan.
